messages:
Maya: Heads up — trying to get PR #4821 (migration guide + Go SDK snippet) merged this afternoon. Need two reviewers and docs preview green. Ping if you can review in the next 2 hours. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tom: I opened that one, it's mostly wording + a small code sample. CC @Priya @Ben for tone/CI.
Priya: Happy to review. Quick note: avoid the phrase 'model owner' — we use 'model maintainer' in the style guide. Also prefer 'Redwood Private' (capitalized) rather than 'private deployment' for consistency. I'll skim examples for voice.
Ben: CI shows docs-preview failing on a broken link (line ~112) and the docs-tone linter flagged 'end-user' vs 'customer' usage. I can push a tiny fix branch if you want. Also please label code fences (```go) for the preview to render properly.
Tom: Thanks — I updated the link and switched 'end-user' -> 'customer' across the doc. Wrapped the snippet with a go fence:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey)
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, prompt)
```
Can you re-run the preview?
Ben: Kicked preview job: https://preview.redwood.dev/pp/4821 — should finish in ~3 mins. Note: docs CI fails if code blocks don't have language. Also the lint rule wants first mention expansions for acronyms.
deploy-bot: docs-preview job #1294 queued by Ben. Status: running.
Priya: Quick tone nit: in 'Security considerations' section expand acronyms on first mention: 'KMS/HSM' -> 'key management systems (KMS) or hardware security modules (HSM)'. Also avoid internal shorthand like 'infra' — use 'infrastructure' in public docs.
Maya: Good catches. Tom, can you apply those two tiny edits so we can merge during the 16:00 UTC merge window? We want to avoid overlapping with the infra deploys at 16:30.
Tom: Done — pushed commit 6f2b9. Added the KMS/HSM expansion and swapped 'infra' -> 'infrastructure'. Also added sign-off: 'Docs: Maya' per process.
Ben: Preview is green and rendering looks correct. Live preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pp/4821/1294 — I'm free to approve once Priya signs off.
Priya: Reviewed the text and examples — LGTM for tone/terminology. One small non-blocking nit: in the routing paragraph, prefer 'compatible model variants' instead of just 'model variants' (clarifies fallback behavior).
Maya: Ok if Ben merges in ~10min? I'll hold the merge slot until 16:05 UTC.
Ben: Merging now. :shipit:
deploy-bot: PR #4821 merged by Ben at 2005123490. docs-deploy job #78 triggered. Status: queued.
